infoPlist.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Wearwell requests speech recognition on first launch for voice chat. It transcribes your words only while voice chat is active.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Wearwell requests microphone access on first launch for voice chat. The microphone is used only while voice chat is active.

plugins.photosPermission: Wearwell requests photo access on first launch so you can choose a wardrobe reference. Selected photos are temporary and are not saved with your item.
plugins.cameraPermission: Wearwell requests camera access on first launch for wardrobe photos. The camera is used only when you tap Take photo.
plugins.microphonePermission: Wearwell requests microphone access on first launch for voice chat. The microphone is used only while voice chat is active.
Wearwell requests microphone access on first launch for voice chat. The microphone is used only while voice chat is active.
plugins.speechRecognitionPermission: Wearwell requests speech recognition on first launch for voice chat. It transcribes your words only while voice chat is active.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Wearwell uses your location only when you enable local weather. It does not track you in the background.
